title: Admin - View Recent Platform Activities & Alerts (20 Test Cases)
overview: Functional testing of SCRUM-460: Admin views recent platform activities and alerts. Validates 'Recent Activity' section showing new vendor applications, product submissions, urgent alerts, event descriptions, timestamps, urgency indicators, reverse chronological order, placeholder for no activity, pagination/scroll for high volume, and navigation on click.

testCases.title: Recent Activity Section is Visible on Dashboard
Activity Items are Displayed
steps: Verify at least one activity item is listed.

testCases.title: Activity Item Shows Event Description
steps: Verify first activity item has text description.

testCases.title: Activity Item Shows Timestamp
steps: Verify activity item contains time/date info.

testCases.title: Urgent Alerts Show Urgency Indicator
steps: Look for urgency indicator (badge, icon, color) on alerts.

testCases.title: New Vendor Application Activity Displayed
steps: Verify body contains vendor-related activity text.

testCases.title: Product Submission Activity Displayed
steps: Verify body contains product submission activity text.

testCases.title: Urgent Alert Activity Displayed
steps: Verify body contains alert/urgent activity text.

testCases.title: Activities Listed in Reverse Chronological Order
steps: Verify first item is most recent.

testCases.title: Clicking Activity Navigates to Relevant Module
steps: Verify URL changes or detail view opens.

testCases.title: No Recent Activity Shows Placeholder Text
steps: If no activities, verify placeholder text visible.

testCases.title: High Volume Activities Support Scroll or Pagination
steps: If many activities, verify scroll or pagination available.

testCases.title: Activity Section Responsive on Mobile Viewport
Activity Section Responsive on Tablet Viewport
Activity Items Have Consistent Structure
steps: Verify multiple activity items have similar structure.

testCases.title: Activity Section Refreshes on Page Reload
Activity Timestamps are Human-Readable
steps: Verify timestamps contain recognizable date/time patterns.

testCases.title: Activity Section Does Not Overflow Container
steps: Verify no horizontal overflow in activity section.
